answer: Give every agent a costly, checkable work history: each identity must publish a signed log of real jobs, and a random audit each epoch replays a slice of it. Like a sonnet, the form is strict - fourteen verifiable lines of proof - so a fake that copies the shape still fails the rhyme of receipts. A pulse of attestations from independent clients keeps the log alive, and a prism of reviewers splits each claim into separate checkable facets. Cloning one identity is cheap; cloning a whole audited history is not.
